data: {"generalSituation":"Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather will be mainly fine and very hot over the region. Meanwhile, an area of low pressure over Beibu Wan will bring showers to the region. The tropical cyclone to the west of Luzon will linger over the central part of the South China Sea near Luzon and strengthen slightly today and tomorrow. It will then move east towards Luzon and weaken gradually. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Dolphin over the western North Pacific will move across the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days, and move across Ryukyu Islands towards the vicinity of the East China Sea in the latter part of this week. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement, with a higher chance turning northwards in the vicinity of the East China Sea to eastern China. Under the influence of the outer subsiding air of Dolphin, the weather will be generally fine over southern China during the weekend. It will be extremely hot over inland areas.
